titles.title: Sing Praises to the Living God

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Sing praises to the living God, Glory Alleluia
Come, adore the living God, Glory Alleluia

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Though sun and moon may pass away, His word will ever stay
His power is for evermore, Glory Alleluia

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Glory to the Trinity, the undivided unity
The father, son and spirit one
From whom all life and goodness come

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
To the living God we sing, Glory Alleluia
Let our love and praises ring, Glory Alleluia

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
To his sons He always gives, His mercy and His love
Praise Him now for evermore, Glory Alleluia

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
To the God who cannot die, Glory Alleluia
To the living God we cry, Glory Alleluia

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
He promised to be with us and He lives in ev'ryone
Love Him now forever more, Glory Alleluia
